tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, Git, code reviews and agile teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer
cover_en.hook: CloudLabs Inc's focus on scalable enterprise solutions immediately caught my attention. I bring over 5 years of hands-on experience building, extending, and supporting large-scale e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) for global enterprises like Rockwell Automation and Shell.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Architecture
bullets.text: Designed and implemented robust backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing, and customer data management following platform best practices.

bullets.label: Headless & OCC REST APIs
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs for storefront and third-party consumers, customizing Interceptors, Populators, and Converters for tailored data flows.

bullets.label: PIM/ERP/MDM Integration
bullets.text: Engineered high-performance data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub to synchronize product catalogs across global channels and resolve integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP and MDM platforms.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Delivery
bullets.text: Bridged business and IT by analyzing requirements, authoring user stories and functional specifications, and translating complex business needs into scalable SAP Commerce solutions within agile teams.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit, and am currently serving my notice period with a last working day on 15 December 2026 (earliest start 16 December 2026). I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my expertise supports CloudLabs Inc.

tailoring.why_company: CloudLabs Inc stands out through its commitment to cutting-edge cloud and e-commerce solutions. I want to bring my 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud expertise from Rockwell Automation and Shell to help your engineering teams build robust, high-performance platforms that drive business growth.
tailoring.motivation_short: Leveraging 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud and Java expertise to deliver scalable enterprise e-commerce solutions at CloudLabs Inc.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! I bring 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) and Java/Spring experience from Rockwell Automation and Shell. Based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit, I'd love to contribute to CloudLabs Inc. My notice period ends Dec 15, 2026. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the SAP Commerce Cloud Developer position at CloudLabs Inc. With over 5 years of professional experience building enterprise platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in Java, Spring, OCC REST APIs, and SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211). 

I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit, and I am available to start on 16 December 2026 following my notice period.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
